nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative trajectories of between-network rsFC were modeled using Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) with a smoothing function applied to age. Thin plate regression splines were used for the age term.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: normative trajectories were modeled with Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) for the training dataset

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: 21 unique between-network resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) values derived from seven large-scale cortical networks (VN, SMN, DAN, VAN, LN, FPN, DMN).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We focus on between-network resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) in our current study.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age (ScanAge) was modeled with a smoothing function. Mean relative motion (QC_meanmotion) was included as a covariate of no interest.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: a smoothing function was applied to age (predictor), where the effective degrees of freedom (edf) statistic reflects the degree of non-linearity of a curve. Mean relative motion was included as a co-variate of no interest.
